source:
@@U02431@@
I order you by my staff, stay calm!
Ah, but my help’s not needed now.
They've come to life, these fearsome monsters!
I see them spread their double pairs of wings!
How quickly they've won the space!
They shake their scaly jaws and fire spews forth!
The crowd flies in every direction!
Now there’s room.

@@U02432@@
(普路托斯 descends from the chariot.)

@@U02433@@
How regally he steps from the chariot!
He signals;
the dragons lift down the chest of gold
with Avarice seated upon it.
It rests now at his feet.
A miracle has happened.

@@U02435@@
(To the BOY CHARIOTEER.)

@@U02436@@
Rid of this all-too-heavy burden,
I set you free.
Hurry off, now,
to that realm
that is uniquely yours.
It is not here.
Here we are surrounded by the
confused, the ugly,
the turbulent, the wild.
Yours is a place where
you can see with clarity,
where you are yours alone,
dependent only on yourself.
There where beauty and goodness
alone give delight—
in solitude.
Create your own world there!
translation:
@@U02431@@
我的工作人员命令你，保持冷静！
啊，不过现在不需要我的帮助了。
这些可怕的怪物复活了！
我看到它们展开双对翅膀！
他们多么快就赢得了这个空间！
它们摇晃着鳞状的下巴，火焰喷涌而出！
人群向四面八方飞去！
现在有空间了。

@@U02432@@
（普路托斯从战车上下来。）

@@U02433@@
他从战车上走下来是多么威严啊！
他发出信号；
龙抬起金箱
上面坐着贪婪。
它现在停在他的脚边。
奇迹发生了。

@@U02435@@
（致战车男孩。）

@@U02436@@
卸下这沉重的包袱，
我让你自由了。
赶紧走吧，
到那个境界
那是你独一无二的。
它不在这里。
在这里，我们被
迷茫、丑陋、
动荡，狂野。
你的地方是
你可以清楚地看到，
那里只有你一个人，
只能依靠你自己。
那里有美丽和善良
独自给予快乐——
在孤独中。
在那里创造你自己的世界！
